title: Path Crossing
summary: Given a string path consisting of 'N', 'S', 'E', or 'W', indicating movement north, south, east, or west by one unit each, starting from the origin (0, 0) on a 2D plane.
statement: Given a string path consisting of 'N', 'S', 'E', or 'W', indicating movement north, south, east, or west by one unit each, starting from the origin (0, 0) on a 2D plane. Determine if the path crosses itself at any point by visiting a location previously traversed. Return true if it crosses, otherwise return false.
constraints: Start at coordinate (0,0) and move one unit per N,S,E,W character.
Return whether any coordinate is visited more than once.
hints: Store the origin in a visited set.
Return true before adding if the new coordinate is already visited.
The set contains exactly the path prefix positions, so membership detects every revisit.
editorial: The set contains exactly the path prefix positions, so membership detects every revisit.

tests.explanation: The visited coordinates are all distinct.
The final west move revisits an earlier coordinate.
